available.conditional_channel_profile: pointwise median profile of nearest class/gradient-matched observed rows
available.low_pass_input: input-specific rFFT truncation retaining DC through registered cutoff
available.matched_observed: observed row matched on model gradients within equilibrium class; source row excluded
available.medoid: observed geometry nearest the robust profile center, optionally within class
available.nearest_neighbour: robustly scaled gradient nearest neighbour within equilibrium class
available.robust_constant: per-channel reference median expanded over z

cyclic_anchor: argmax joint robust-standardized energy across all channels
support_warning: robust per-channel scaling + PCA + held-out nearest-neighbour distance; two-sided tails; not proof of physical validity
